# Environment actions

The environment plane is everything inside **one environment**: its organizations, users, applications, APIs, keys, sign-in configuration and governance. It is served on the environment's own host.

Every row below is one action, reached through four doors that run the same code, with the same authorization, validation, approvals and [Audit log](../guides/activity-log.md) entry: the console, the REST API, the MCP server and the `cbox` CLI. See [Actions](../core-concepts/actions.md) for how that works and [Planes and hosts](../core-concepts/planes-and-hosts.md) for where each plane is served.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `https://<environment-host>/api/v1/…` with `Authorization: Bearer cbid_env_…` (a secret key of that environment), or a token a person delegated. At the platform root, a team member's token names the environment in a `Cbox-Environment` header |
| MCP | `/mcp` on the environment's host. At the platform root's `/mcp`, every environment tool takes an `environment` argument (an id or slug from `whoami`) |
| CLI | `cbox login`, `cbox id use <environment>`, then the command below — or `CBOX_ID_ENDPOINT` + `CBOX_ID_TOKEN=cbid_env_…` for CI |
| OpenAPI | `/api/v1/environment/openapi.yaml` on the host above — public, no key needed ([source](https://github.com/cboxdk/cbox-id/blob/main/resources/openapi/environment.yaml)); every operation carries `x-action`, `x-scope` and `x-danger` |

Danger is how much harm the action can do in the wrong hands: `read` only reads; `write` changes something another write can undo; `destructive` removes or revokes; `critical` mints credentials, takes over access or changes how people sign in. MCP clients are told a destructive or critical tool is destructive, the CLI asks before running one, and an [approval policy](../core-concepts/approvals.md) keys on it.

## Admin Portal

### organizations.portal_links.create

Create a one-time Admin Portal link an organization's IT administrator uses to set up SSO, directory sync, domain verification, log streams or SAML certificate renewal, or to read its audit logs, without an account. The URL is shown once.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/portal-links` → `201` |
| Scope | `portal_links:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `organizations_portal_links_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id organizations portal_links create <organization_id>` |
| Secret | `data.url` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes | The organization the link sets up. At most 64 characters. |
| `intents` | list of string | yes | What the link may set up: sso (connection and email domains), dsync (directory sync over SCIM), domain_verification, log_streams, certificate_renewal (a SAML connection's signing certificate), audit_logs (the organization's audit events, read-only, with CSV export). At least 1 items. |
| `expires_in_minutes` | integer, nullable | no | How long the link may wait to be opened, in minutes — 5 to 10080 (a week). Left out, the deployment's default (30). At least 5. At most 10080. |
| `email` | string (email), nullable | no | Mail the link to this address — the customer's IT contact. Left out, nothing is sent. At most 254 characters. |
| `locale` | string, nullable | no | The language of that mail. Left out, the environment's default language. One of `en`, `da`, `de`, `sv`, `nb`, `fr`. |

### organizations.portal_links.list

List an organization's Admin Portal links from the last 30 days, newest first: what each opens, who minted it, whom it was mailed to, and whether it is pending, in use, completed, expired or revoked. Never the URL.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/portal-links` → `200` |
| Scope | `portal_links:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `organizations_portal_links_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id organizations portal_links list <organization_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes | The organization id. At most 64 characters. |

### organizations.portal_links.revoke

Withdraw an Admin Portal link: it can no longer be opened, and a setup session it already opened ends on its next request. What was already set up through it stays.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/portal-links/{id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `portal_links:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `organizations_portal_links_revoke` |
| CLI | `cbox id organizations portal_links revoke <organization_id> <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes | The organization id. At most 64 characters. |
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The portal link's id. At most 64 characters. |

## API keys

### api_keys.list

List the API keys an organization's members created for your apps, a page at a time. Never the key material.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/api-keys` → `200` |
| Scope | `api_keys:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `api_keys_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id api_keys list <organization_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes | The organization id. At most 64 characters. |
| `client_id` | string | no | Only the keys for this app's API. At most 255 characters. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `after` | string | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

### api_keys.revoke

Revoke an API key an organization's member created for your app. Whatever uses it stops working at once.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/api-keys/{id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `api_keys:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `api_keys_revoke` |
| CLI | `cbox id api_keys revoke <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The API key id. At most 64 characters. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization it must belong to; a key elsewhere is not found. At most 64 characters. |

## APIs

### apis.create

Register an API (resource server): its identifier becomes the access token audience, and it owns its scopes.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/apis` → `201` |
| Scope | `apis:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `apis_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id apis create` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | string (uri) | yes | An absolute URI (RFC 8707), for example https://api.example.com. Becomes the token `aud`. At most 255 characters. |
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | Make it one organization's API. Left out, the environment owns it. At most 64 characters. |
| `client_id` | string, nullable | no | The app whose roles and permissions the API enforces. Must have the API's owner. At most 255 characters. |
| `scopes` | list of object | no | At most 200 items. |
| `scopes[].key` | string | yes | The scope key, unique across the environment: `tax:assess`. At most 128 characters. |
| `scopes[].description` | string, nullable | no | What the scope lets an app do, in plain words. At most 255 characters. |
| `scopes[].tenant_requestable` | boolean | no | Whether organizations' own apps may request it. Default true. |

### apis.delete

Delete an API and its scopes. Existing tokens keep their audience until they expire.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/apis/{id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `apis:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `apis_delete` |
| CLI | `cbox id apis delete <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The API id. |

### apis.get

Get one registered API and its scopes.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/apis/{id}` → `200` |
| Scope | `apis:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `apis_get` |
| CLI | `cbox id apis get <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The API id. |

### apis.list

List the APIs (resource servers) registered in this environment, with their scopes.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/apis` → `200` |
| Scope | `apis:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `apis_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id apis list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `after` | string | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

### apis.scopes.define

Add a scope to an API, or change the description or tenant access of one it owns.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `PUT /api/v1/apis/{id}/scopes/{key}` → `200` |
| Scope | `apis:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `apis_scopes_define` |
| CLI | `cbox id apis scopes define <id> <key>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The API id. |
| `key` | string (path) | yes | The scope key: `tax:assess`. At most 128 characters. |
| `description` | string, nullable | no | At most 255 characters. |
| `tenant_requestable` | boolean | no | Whether organizations' own apps may request it. Default true. |

### apis.scopes.remove

Remove a scope from an API. Apps holding it keep it as a plain scope that no longer reaches the API.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/apis/{id}/scopes/{key}` → `204` |
| Scope | `apis:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `apis_scopes_remove` |
| CLI | `cbox id apis scopes remove <id> <key>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The API id. |
| `key` | string (path) | yes | The scope key. At most 128 characters. |

### apis.update

Rename an API, link or unlink its app, and optionally replace its complete scope set.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `PATCH /api/v1/apis/{id}` → `200` |
| Scope | `apis:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `apis_update` |
| CLI | `cbox id apis update <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The API id. |
| `name` | string | no | At most 120 characters. |
| `client_id` | string, nullable | no | The app to link; null unlinks it. Left out, the link is unchanged. At most 255 characters. |
| `scopes` | list of object | no | The COMPLETE scope set afterwards. Left out, scopes are unchanged. At most 200 items. |
| `scopes[].key` | string | yes | The scope key, unique across the environment: `tax:assess`. At most 128 characters. |
| `scopes[].description` | string, nullable | no | What the scope lets an app do, in plain words. At most 255 characters. |
| `scopes[].tenant_requestable` | boolean | no | Whether organizations' own apps may request it. Default true. |

## App audit logs

### audit_logs.events.create

Record 1–100 audit events your app's users caused, each for one of your organizations (customers); checked against the action's schema when it has one and appended to that organization's tamper-evident chain. Send an Idempotency-Key.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/audit-logs/events` → `201` |
| Scope | `audit_logs:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `audit_logs_events_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id audit_logs events create` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events` | list of object | yes | 1–100 events, recorded all together or not at all. At least 1 items. At most 100 items. |
| `events[].organization_id` | string | yes | The organization (your customer) the event happened in. At most 64 characters. |
| `events[].action` | string | yes | What happened, as dotted words: `invoice.voided`, `user.signed_in`. At most 190 characters. |
| `events[].occurred_at` | string (date-time) | yes | When it happened: ISO 8601 with a time zone, to the millisecond. |
| `events[].actor` | object | yes |  |
| `events[].actor.id` | string | yes | Your id for whoever did it. At most 190 characters. |
| `events[].actor.type` | string | yes | What kind of actor: `user`, `api_key`, `system`. At most 100 characters. |
| `events[].actor.name` | string, nullable | no | A name a person reads in the log. At most 190 characters. |
| `events[].actor.metadata` | object | no | Up to 50 names to strings, numbers, booleans or null. |
| `events[].targets` | list of object | no | What it was done to. At most 50 items. |
| `events[].targets[].id` | string | yes | At most 190 characters. |
| `events[].targets[].type` | string | yes | What kind of thing: `invoice`, `user`, `report`. At most 100 characters. |
| `events[].targets[].name` | string, nullable | no | At most 190 characters. |
| `events[].targets[].metadata` | object | no |  |
| `events[].context` | object | no |  |
| `events[].context.location` | string, nullable | no | Where it came from — usually the client's IP address. At most 64 characters. |
| `events[].context.user_agent` | string, nullable | no | At most 512 characters. |
| `events[].metadata` | object | no | Up to 50 names to strings, numbers, booleans or null; values up to 500 characters. |

### audit_logs.events.list

Read audit events newest first, for one organization or the whole environment, filtered by action, actor, target and time range; pass `next_cursor` as `after` to page.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/audit-logs/events` → `200` |
| Scope | `audit_logs:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `audit_logs_events_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id audit_logs events list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string | no | Only this organization's events. Required in effect for an organization's own administrator, whose events are the only ones they see. At most 64 characters. |
| `actions` | list of string | no | Only these actions, e.g. `invoice.voided`. At most 50 items. |
| `actor_id` | string | no | Only events this actor caused. At most 190 characters. |
| `target_id` | string | no | Only events naming this target. At most 190 characters. |
| `range_start` | string (date-time) | no | Only events that occurred at or after this time. |
| `range_end` | string (date-time) | no | Only events that occurred before this time. |
| `order` | string | no | `desc` (default) for newest first, `asc` for oldest first. One of `desc`, `asc`. |

| `after` | string | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. At most 200 characters. |

### audit_logs.exports.create

| `actions` | list of string | no | Only these actions, e.g. `invoice.voided`. At most 50 items. |
| `actor_id` | string | no | Only events this actor caused. At most 190 characters. |
| `target_id` | string | no | Only events naming this target. At most 190 characters. |
| `range_start` | string (date-time) | no | Only events that occurred at or after this time. |
| `range_end` | string (date-time) | no | Only events that occurred before this time. |

### apps.copy

Copy an app into another environment of this project, with a new client id and secret there. A person on the environment console only; a key exports the blueprint instead.

### apps.create

Register an app (OAuth client) from a short form (name and type) or from another environment's blueprint. A confidential app's client_secret is returned once.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/apps` → `201` |
| Scope | `apps:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `apps_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id apps create` |
| Secret | `data.client_secret` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blueprint` | object | no | A blueprint document from `GET /apps/{id}/blueprint`. Left out, the short form below describes the app. |
| `name` | string | no | Required without a blueprint; beside one, it replaces the blueprint's. At most 190 characters. |
| `type` | string | no | The kind of app. Default `web`. One of `web`, `spa`, `cli`, `service`, `agent`, `advanced`. |
| `client_type` | string | no | Required for `advanced`. One of `public`, `confidential`. |
| `grant_types` | list of string | no | Required for `advanced`. |
| `redirect_uris` | list of string | no | At most 50 items. |
| `post_logout_redirect_uris` | list of string | no | At most 50 items. |
| `scopes` | list of string | no | Left out, the kind's default scopes. At most 100 items. |
| `first_party` | boolean | no | Skips the consent screen. Default false. |
| `manifest_url` | string (uri), nullable | no | Where the app publishes its roles-and-permissions manifest. At most 500 characters. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The owning organization; null for the environment's own app. At most 64 characters. |
| `jwks` | object | no | A public JWK Set, for a `private_key_jwt` app. Never part of a blueprint. |

| CLI | `cbox id sso connections activate <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | Only if it is this organization's; anything else is a 404. At most 64 characters. |

### sso.connections.certificates.activate

Make a staged SAML signing certificate the connection's primary. The certificate it replaces stops being trusted.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/sso/connections/{id}/certificates/activate` → `200` |
| Scope | `sso:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |

| `fingerprint_sha256` | string | yes | The staged certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint, as the certificate list gives it. At most 200 characters. |

List a SAML connection's signing certificates — primary and staged — with each one's fingerprint and expiry.

| | |

### sso.connections.certificates.stage

Stage a SAML connection's new IdP signing certificate (PEM or IdP metadata) beside the current one, so a renewal has no outage. Activate it once the IdP signs with it.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/sso/connections/{id}/certificates` → `200` |
| Scope | `sso:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `sso_connections_certificates_stage` |
| CLI | `cbox id sso connections certificates stage <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The connection's id. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | Only if it is this organization's; anything else is a 404. At most 64 characters. |
| `certificate` | string, nullable | no | The new signing certificate, PEM. Send this or metadata. At most 20000 characters. |
| `metadata` | string, nullable | no | The identity provider's metadata XML, or the https URL it is published at. Send this or certificate. At most 500000 characters. |

### sso.connections.create

Connect an organization's SAML or OIDC identity provider as a draft. Activate it to start signing people in through it.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/sso/connections` → `201` |
| Scope | `sso:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `sso_connections_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id sso connections create` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization the connection belongs to. Send this or environment_wide. At most 64 characters. |
| `environment_wide` | boolean | no | True to make the connection the environment's own rather than one organization's. Send this or organization_id. |
| `name` | string | yes | What administrators call it: "Okta", "Entra ID". At most 120 characters. |
| `type` | string | yes | saml or oidc. The config fields of that type are required, unless pending_idp. One of `saml`, `oidc`. |
| `pending_idp` | boolean | no | True to create the draft before the identity provider's details are known: the answer's service_provider is what to paste into it. Complete it with update before activating. |
| `idp_entity_id` | string, nullable | no | SAML: the identity provider's entity id. At most 500 characters. |
| `idp_sso_url` | string (uri), nullable | no | SAML: the identity provider's single sign-on URL. At most 500 characters. |
| `idp_x509cert` | string, nullable | no | SAML: the identity provider's signing certificate (PEM). Write-only. At most 20000 characters. |
| `sp_entity_id` | string, nullable | no | SAML: the entity id this environment presents as the service provider. Left out on create, this connection's own. At most 500 characters. |
| `sp_acs_url` | string (uri), nullable | no | SAML: where the identity provider posts its assertions. Left out on create, this connection's own ACS URL. At most 500 characters. |
| `issuer` | string (uri), nullable | no | OIDC: the provider's issuer URL; its endpoints are discovered from it. At most 500 characters. |
| `client_id` | string, nullable | no | OIDC: the client id registered at the provider. At most 500 characters. |
| `client_secret` | string, nullable | no | OIDC: the client secret. Write-only. At most 500 characters. |
| `signing_key` | string, nullable | no | OIDC, optional: the provider's ID-token signing key (an RS256 public key, PEM). Leave it out for any provider whose discovery document publishes a jwks_uri — the keys are read from there and follow its rotations. Needed only when it does not. Write-only. At most 20000 characters. |

## Log streams

### log_streams.create

Stream the audit trail to a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Graylog, CEF, JSON), Datadog, or an S3 or GCS bucket. A generated HMAC key is returned once.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/log-streams` → `201` |
| Scope | `log_streams:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `log_streams_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id log_streams create` |
| Secret | `data.secret` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | At most 190 characters. |
| `destination` | string | yes | One of `splunk_hec`, `elastic_ecs`, `graylog_gelf`, `cef_http`, `generic_json`, `datadog`, `s3`, `gcs`. |
| `endpoint_url` | string (uri), nullable | no | An HTTP collector: the public URL entries are POSTed to (required). Datadog, S3 and GCS: leave out for the destination's own endpoint, or an https URL of an S3-compatible store (MinIO, R2). At most 2048 characters. |
| `auth` | string | no | An HTTP collector: how the endpoint is authenticated. Left out, the destination's default. The cloud destinations authenticate their own way. One of `none`, `bearer`, `splunk`, `hmac`. |
| `secret` | string, nullable | no | The credential, never echoed: the bearer or Splunk token (HTTP collectors; left out with `hmac`, a key is generated and returned once), the Datadog API key, the S3 secret access key (none with `role_arn`), or the GCS service-account JSON key. At most 8192 characters. |
| `options` | object | no | Datadog, S3 and GCS only: the destination's settings. An HTTP collector takes none. |
| `options.site` | string, nullable | no | Datadog: the site your account lives on — the domain you sign in at, e.g. `datadoghq.eu` for EU1. Default `datadoghq.com` (US1). An API key only works on its own site. One of `datadoghq.com`, `us3.datadoghq.com`, `us5.datadoghq.com`, `datadoghq.eu`, `ap1.datadoghq.com`, `ap2.datadoghq.com`, `ddog-gov.com`. |
| `options.service` | string, nullable | no | Datadog: the `service` attribute on every entry. Default: this platform's name. At most 100 characters. |
| `options.source` | string, nullable | no | Datadog: the `ddsource` attribute. Default `cbox`. At most 100 characters. |
| `options.tags` | list of string, nullable | no | Datadog: `key:value` tags (`ddtags`) on every entry, e.g. `env:prod`. At most 100 items. |
| `options.hostname` | string, nullable | no | Datadog: the `hostname` attribute. Default: this platform's host. At most 255 characters. |
| `options.bucket` | string, nullable | no | S3 and GCS: the bucket objects are written to. At most 222 characters. |
| `options.region` | string, nullable | no | S3: the bucket's AWS Region, e.g. `eu-west-1` (`auto` for Cloudflare R2). At most 32 characters. |
| `options.prefix` | string, nullable | no | S3 and GCS: the object key prefix, e.g. `cbox/audit`. Objects are written to `{prefix}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{hh}/{batch}.ndjson.gz`. At most 512 characters. |
| `options.access_key_id` | string, nullable | no | S3 with an access key: the IAM access key ID. Its secret access key is the stream's `secret`. At most 128 characters. |
| `options.role_arn` | string, nullable | no | S3 with an assumed role: the IAM role the platform assumes. No secret is stored; the role's trust policy must require the stream's `external_id`. At most 2048 characters. |
| `options.sse` | string, nullable | no | S3: server-side encryption requested on every object. Left out, the bucket's default. One of `AES256`, `aws:kms`. |
| `options.kms_key_id` | string, nullable | no | S3 with `aws:kms`: the KMS key ID, alias or ARN. At most 2048 characters. |
| `options.path_style` | boolean, nullable | no | S3: path-style addressing. Default: virtual-hosted on AWS, path-style on a custom endpoint (MinIO, R2). |
| `options.gzip` | boolean, nullable | no | S3 and GCS: gzip each object (`.ndjson.gz`). Default true. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization it belongs to; it carries that organization's traffic only. Send this or environment_wide. At most 64 characters. |
| `environment_wide` | boolean | no | True to make it the environment's own, carrying EVERY organization's traffic. Send this or organization_id. |

| `destination` | string | no | Changing it starts the stream's options and credential afresh. One of `splunk_hec`, `elastic_ecs`, `graylog_gelf`, `cef_http`, `generic_json`, `datadog`, `s3`, `gcs`. |
| `endpoint_url` | string (uri), nullable | no | An HTTP collector's URL; for Datadog, S3 and GCS empty means the destination's own endpoint. At most 2048 characters. |
| `auth` | string | no | An HTTP collector only. One of `none`, `bearer`, `splunk`, `hmac`. |
| `secret` | string, nullable | no | A new credential (token, API key, secret access key or service-account JSON key). Left out, the current one is kept. Never echoed. At most 8192 characters. |
| `options` | object | no | Datadog, S3 and GCS only: the destination's settings. An HTTP collector takes none. |
| `options.site` | string, nullable | no | Datadog: the site your account lives on — the domain you sign in at, e.g. `datadoghq.eu` for EU1. Default `datadoghq.com` (US1). An API key only works on its own site. One of `datadoghq.com`, `us3.datadoghq.com`, `us5.datadoghq.com`, `datadoghq.eu`, `ap1.datadoghq.com`, `ap2.datadoghq.com`, `ddog-gov.com`. |
| `options.service` | string, nullable | no | Datadog: the `service` attribute on every entry. Default: this platform's name. At most 100 characters. |
| `options.source` | string, nullable | no | Datadog: the `ddsource` attribute. Default `cbox`. At most 100 characters. |
| `options.tags` | list of string, nullable | no | Datadog: `key:value` tags (`ddtags`) on every entry, e.g. `env:prod`. At most 100 items. |
| `options.hostname` | string, nullable | no | Datadog: the `hostname` attribute. Default: this platform's host. At most 255 characters. |
| `options.bucket` | string, nullable | no | S3 and GCS: the bucket objects are written to. At most 222 characters. |
| `options.region` | string, nullable | no | S3: the bucket's AWS Region, e.g. `eu-west-1` (`auto` for Cloudflare R2). At most 32 characters. |
| `options.prefix` | string, nullable | no | S3 and GCS: the object key prefix, e.g. `cbox/audit`. Objects are written to `{prefix}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{hh}/{batch}.ndjson.gz`. At most 512 characters. |
| `options.access_key_id` | string, nullable | no | S3 with an access key: the IAM access key ID. Its secret access key is the stream's `secret`. At most 128 characters. |
| `options.role_arn` | string, nullable | no | S3 with an assumed role: the IAM role the platform assumes. No secret is stored; the role's trust policy must require the stream's `external_id`. At most 2048 characters. |
| `options.sse` | string, nullable | no | S3: server-side encryption requested on every object. Left out, the bucket's default. One of `AES256`, `aws:kms`. |
| `options.kms_key_id` | string, nullable | no | S3 with `aws:kms`: the KMS key ID, alias or ARN. At most 2048 characters. |
| `options.path_style` | boolean, nullable | no | S3: path-style addressing. Default: virtual-hosted on AWS, path-style on a custom endpoint (MinIO, R2). |
| `options.gzip` | boolean, nullable | no | S3 and GCS: gzip each object (`.ndjson.gz`). Default true. |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | True to deliver; false to stop, keeping what is pending. |

## Members

### members.add

Add an existing user to an organization on a tier (`admin` or `member`), optionally with access roles. Name them by `user_id` or `email`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/members` → `201` |
| Scope | `members:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `members_add` |
| CLI | `cbox id members add <organization_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes | The organization id. At most 64 characters. |
| `user_id` | string | no | The user to add. Or name them by `email`. At most 64 characters. |
| `email` | string (email) | no | The address of the user to add, instead of `user_id`. At most 190 characters. |
| `role` | string | no | The tier. Default `member`; ownership moves with transfer-ownership. One of `admin`, `member`. |
| `roles` | list of string | no | Access roles to grant in the organization: ids, or manifest keys of `client_id`'s app. At most 50 items. |
| `client_id` | string, nullable | no | The app whose manifest keys `roles` are. At most 255 characters. |

### members.list

List an organization's members, a page at a time, with each one's tier, status, name and email.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/members` → `200` |
| Scope | `members:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `members_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id members list <organization_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes | The organization id. At most 64 characters. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `after` | string | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

### members.remove

Remove a member from an organization, with every role they held there. The last owner cannot be removed.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/members/{user_id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `members:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `members_remove` |
| CLI | `cbox id members remove <organization_id> <user_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes | The organization id. At most 64 characters. |
| `user_id` | string (path) | yes | The member's user id. At most 64 characters. |

### members.update

Change a member's tier to `admin` or `member`. Ownership moves with transfer-ownership; the last owner cannot be demoted.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `PATCH /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/members/{user_id}` → `200` |
| Scope | `members:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `members_update` |
| CLI | `cbox id members update <organization_id> <user_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes | The organization id. At most 64 characters. |
| `user_id` | string (path) | yes | The member's user id. At most 64 characters. |
| `role` | string | yes | One of `admin`, `member`. |

## Outbound provisioning

### provisioning.targets.create

Register a downstream app this platform pushes an organization's people to over SCIM, or every organization's with environment_wide.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/provisioning-targets` → `201` |
| Scope | `provisioning:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `provisioning_targets_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id provisioning targets create` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization the target belongs to. Send this or environment_wide. At most 64 characters. |
| `environment_wide` | boolean | no | True to make the target the environment's own rather than one organization's. Send this or organization_id. |
| `name` | string | yes | What administrators call it: "Slack", "Salesforce". At most 190 characters. |
| `base_url` | string (uri) | yes | The target's SCIM base URL. Must be a public address. At most 500 characters. |
| `auth_scheme` | string | yes | bearer (a long-lived token the app issued you) or oauth2_client_credentials (a token fetched before each batch). One of `bearer`, `oauth2_client_credentials`. |
| `secret` | string | yes | The bearer token, or the OAuth client secret. Write-only. At most 4096 characters. |
| `token_url` | string (uri), nullable | no | oauth2_client_credentials: the token endpoint. At most 2048 characters. |
| `client_id` | string, nullable | no | oauth2_client_credentials: the client id. At most 400 characters. |
| `scope` | string, nullable | no | oauth2_client_credentials: the scope to ask for, if the app wants one. At most 400 characters. |

## SAML apps

### saml_apps.create

Register a SAML app that signs people in with their account here. Decides where assertions — and their attributes — are sent.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/saml-apps` → `201` |
| Scope | `saml_apps:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `saml_apps_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id saml_apps create` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_id` | string | yes | The application's SAML EntityID, unique in this environment. At most 500 characters. |
| `acs_url` | string (uri) | yes | Where assertions are posted: https (http only on localhost), absolute, no fragment. At most 1000 characters. |
| `name_id_format` | string | no | The NameID format URN. Default emailAddress. One of `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`, `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent`, `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient`, `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified`. |
| `name_id_attribute` | string | no | The person's field the NameID is read from. Default `email`. At most 120 characters. |
| `attribute_mappings` | list of object | no | The attributes the assertion carries. Sent, it is the COMPLETE list afterwards. At most 100 items. |
| `attribute_mappings[].attribute` | string | yes | The attribute name the assertion emits: `email`, `displayName`. At most 190 characters. |
| `attribute_mappings[].field` | string | yes | The person's field it is read from: `email`, `name`. At most 190 characters. |
| `want_authn_requests_signed` | boolean | no | Verify the application's signature on every AuthnRequest. Needs a certificate. |
| `certificate` | string, nullable | no | The application's signing certificate (PEM). Write-only; left out or null keeps the one on file. At most 20000 characters. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization that owns the application: only its active members are signed in to it, and the assertion names it. Null makes it environment-wide — every person in the environment may sign in to it. At most 64 characters. |

### saml_apps.delete

Remove a SAML app. People can no longer sign in to it with their account here.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/saml-apps/{id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `saml_apps:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `saml_apps_delete` |
| CLI | `cbox id saml_apps delete <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The SAML app's id. |

Read one SAML app: its entity id, ACS URL, NameID and attribute mappings. Never its certificate.

|---|---|

| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `saml_apps_get` |

|---|---|---|---|

One of `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`, `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent`, `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient`, `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified`. |
| `name_id_attribute` | string | no | The person's field the NameID is read from. Default `email`. At most 120 characters. |
| `attribute_mappings` | list of object | no | The attributes the assertion carries. Sent, it is the COMPLETE list afterwards. At most 100 items. |
| `attribute_mappings[].attribute` | string | yes | The attribute name the assertion emits: `email`, `displayName`. At most 190 characters. |

## Secret keys

### keys.create

Mint a management key for this environment, at most as wide as the caller. The value is returned once, as `token`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/keys` → `201` |
| Scope | `keys:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `keys_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys create` |
| Secret | `data.token` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `scopes` | list of string | yes | The scopes the key carries. From a key: a subset of its own. At least 1 items. At most 64 items. |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time), nullable | no | When it stops working. From a key: required to be no later than the parent; defaults to the latest allowed. |
| `description` | string, nullable | no | What it is for — shown beside it in the console. At most 500 characters. |
| `require_approval` | object | no | Which of this key's actions need its owner's approval on their device first. From a key: never weaker than its own. |
| `require_approval.min_danger` | string, nullable | no | Every action at or above this danger waits for a person's approval. One of `write`, `destructive`, `critical`. |
| `require_approval.actions` | list of string | no | These actions wait for approval whatever their danger. At most 100 items. |

### keys.list

List this environment's management keys (names, scopes, parents, expiry, last use — never their values).

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/keys` → `200` |
| Scope | `keys:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `keys_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `after` | string | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

### keys.revoke

Revoke a management key and every key it minted, immediately.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/keys/{id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `keys:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `keys_revoke` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys revoke <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The key to revoke. |

### keys.rotate

Rotate a management key: mint a successor with the same scopes and retire the old one after a grace period.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/keys/{id}/rotate` → `201` |
| Scope | `keys:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `keys_rotate` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys rotate <id>` |
| Secret | `data.token` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The key to rotate. |
| `grace_hours` | integer | no | How long the old key keeps working. Default 24. At least 0. At most 168. |

Drop one organization's authentication policy override, so it inherits the environment baseline again.

| | |
|---|---|

### signin.policy.update

Change the authentication policy of the environment baseline, or tighten one organization's override. Requiring SSO signs out password sessions.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `PATCH /api/v1/sign-in/policy` → `200` |
| Scope | `signin:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `signin_policy_update` |
| CLI | `cbox id signin policy update` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | Write this organization's override. Left out, the environment baseline. At most 64 characters. |
| `min_length` | integer | no | Minimum password length. At least 8. At most 128. |
| `require_breach_check` | boolean | no | Refuse passwords that appear in known breaches. |
| `max_age_days` | integer, nullable | no | Days before a password must be changed; null for no limit. At least 1. At most 3650. |
| `reuse_history` | integer | no | How many previous passwords may not be reused. At least 0. At most 24. |
| `mfa` | string | no | Whether a second factor is off, optional or required. One of `off`, `optional`, `required`. |
| `sso` | string | no | Whether SSO is off, preferred, or required — `required` refuses every other way in and signs out password sessions. One of `off`, `preferred`, `required`. |
| `lockout_threshold` | integer, nullable | no | Failed attempts before an account is locked; null for the deployment default (10 inside 15 minutes unless CBOX_ID_LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD says otherwise). At least 3. At most 100. |

### support_sessions.end

End a support session now: every token it issued is revoked.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/support-sessions/{id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `support:write` — required of the key or token. |

| MCP tool | `support_sessions_end` |
| CLI | `cbox id support_sessions end <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The support session id. At most 64 characters. |

### support_sessions.start

Start a support session: a staff member holding the app's support:impersonate acts as a customer's user in that app, for a reason and at most an hour. Optionally returns the first authorization code.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/support-sessions` → `201` |
| Scope | `support:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `support_sessions_start` |
| CLI | `cbox id support_sessions start` |
| Secret | `data.code` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | string | yes | The customer's user to act as. At most 64 characters. |
| `organization_id` | string | yes | The organization they are acted as in — one they are an active member of. At most 64 characters. |
| `client_id` | string | yes | The first-party app the session signs in to. At most 255 characters. |
| `actor_user_id` | string | yes | The staff member acting. They must hold the app's support:impersonate everywhere. At most 64 characters. |
| `reason` | string | yes | Why — on both audit trails and shown to the customer. At most 500 characters. |
| `ttl_minutes` | integer | no | How long it lasts. Default and maximum: the configured limit. At least 1. At most 60. |
| `scopes` | list of string | no | The scopes its tokens carry; settled to what one API can be audienced. At most 50 items. |
| `redirect_uri` | string | no | With `code_challenge`: return the session's first authorization code for this redirect URI. At most 2048 characters. |
| `code_challenge` | string | no | An S256 PKCE challenge: 43 base64url characters. At most 43 characters. |
| `nonce` | string, nullable | no | At most 255 characters. |

## Token vault

### token_vault.grants.create

Grant an app (by OAuth client id) the right to lease a stored credential.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/token-vault/secrets/{id}/grants` → `200` |
| Scope | `token_vault:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `token_vault_grants_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id token_vault grants create <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The secret's id. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization whose vault this is. Left out: the environment's own secrets, a separate collection. At most 64 characters. |
| `client_id` | string | yes | The OAuth client id of the app that may lease it. At most 190 characters. |

### token_vault.grants.delete

Withdraw an app's right to lease a stored credential.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/token-vault/secrets/{id}/grants/{client_id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `token_vault:write` — required of the key or token. |

| MCP tool | `token_vault_grants_delete` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The secret's id. |
| `client_id` | string (path) | yes | The OAuth client id whose grant is withdrawn. At most 190 characters. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization whose vault this is. Left out: the environment's own secrets, a separate collection. At most 64 characters. |

### token_vault.secrets.create

Store a downstream credential (a third-party API key) in an organization's token vault, or the environment's own. The value is sealed and never returned.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/token-vault/secrets` → `201` |
| Scope | `token_vault:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `token_vault_secrets_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id token_vault secrets create` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization whose vault this is. Left out: the environment's own secrets, a separate collection. At most 64 characters. |
| `name` | string | yes | What it is: "Stripe live key". At most 190 characters. |
| `provider` | string | yes | Whose credential it is: "stripe", "openai". At most 190 characters. |
| `secret` | string | yes | The credential. Write-only: sealed, never returned. At most 20000 characters. |

### token_vault.secrets.get

Read one stored credential and the client ids granted to lease it. Never its value.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/token-vault/secrets/{id}` → `200` |
| Scope | `token_vault:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `token_vault_secrets_get` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The secret's id. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization whose vault this is. Left out: the environment's own secrets, a separate collection. At most 64 characters. |

### token_vault.secrets.list

List the downstream credentials stored in an organization's token vault (or the environment's own): names, providers, status. Never a value.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/token-vault/secrets` → `200` |
| Scope | `token_vault:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `token_vault_secrets_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id token_vault secrets list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization whose vault this is. Left out: the environment's own secrets, a separate collection. At most 64 characters. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `after` | string | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

### token_vault.secrets.revoke

Revoke a stored credential permanently. No app can lease it again.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/token-vault/secrets/{id}/revoke` → `200` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The secret's id. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization whose vault this is. Left out: the environment's own secrets, a separate collection. At most 64 characters. |

### token_vault.secrets.rotate

Replace a stored credential's value. Every later lease hands out the new one. The value is never returned.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/token-vault/secrets/{id}/rotate` → `200` |
| Scope | `token_vault:write` — required of the key or token. |

| MCP tool | `token_vault_secrets_rotate` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The secret's id. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization whose vault this is. Left out: the environment's own secrets, a separate collection. At most 64 characters. |
| `secret` | string | yes | The new value. Write-only: sealed, never returned. At most 20000 characters. |

## Users

### users.create

Create a user in this environment, optionally with a password, and optionally mail them a one-click sign-in link.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/users` → `201` |
| Scope | `users:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `users_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id users create` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string (email) | yes | At most 190 characters. |
| `name` | string, nullable | no | At most 190 characters. |
| `password` | string, nullable | no | Checked against this environment's password policy. Leave out for a user who signs in another way. At least 8 characters. At most 255 characters. |
| `send_sign_in_link` | boolean | no | Mail the new user a one-click sign-in link. Default false. |

### users.deactivate

Deactivate a user: they can no longer sign in, and every OAuth grant they hold is revoked. Never deletes them.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}` → `200` |
| Scope | `users:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `users_deactivate` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The user id. At most 64 characters. |

### users.erase

Erase a person (GDPR Art. 17): revoke their sessions and tokens, delete their credentials, memberships and personal data, and pseudonymise their account. Cannot be undone.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/users/{id}/erase` → `200` |
| Scope | `users:erase` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `users_erase` |
| CLI | `cbox id users erase <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The user's id. |

### users.get

Get one user of this environment by id.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/users/{id}` → `200` |

| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `users_get` |
| CLI | `cbox id users get <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The user id. At most 64 characters. |

### users.list

List the users in this environment, a page at a time. Narrow by exact `email`, a `q` fragment of the address or name, or `status`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/users` → `200` |
| Scope | `users:read` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `users_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id users list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `after` | string | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |
| `email` | string | no | Only the user with exactly this address (case-insensitive). At most 190 characters. |

| `status` | string | no | Only users in this state. One of `active`, `disabled`, `locked`. |

### users.mfa.reset

Reset a user's two-factor authentication: their authenticator and recovery codes are removed and they must enrol again.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}/mfa` → `204` |
| Scope | `users:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The user id. At most 64 characters. |

### users.password.set

Set a user's password, temporary by default, and mail it to them unless told not to. Signs them out according to `revoke`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/users/{id}/password` → `200` |
| Scope | `users:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `users_password_set` |
| CLI | `cbox id users password set <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The user id. At most 64 characters. |
| `password` | string | yes | The new password. Checked against this environment's password policy. At most 200 characters. |
| `reason` | string | yes | Why — recorded on the audit trail. At most 200 characters. |
| `temporary` | boolean | no | The user must choose a new password at their next sign-in. Default true. |
| `expires_in_hours` | integer | no | A temporary password stops working after this many hours. 0 or absent: until changed. At least 0. At most 8760. |
| `revoke` | string | no | How much existing access to end. Default `sessions_and_tokens`. One of `sessions_and_tokens`, `sessions_only`, `nothing`. |
| `send_email` | boolean | no | Mail the password to the user. Default true. |

Mail a user a password-reset link at their own address.

## Webhooks

### webhooks.create

Register a webhook endpoint for one organization or the whole environment. Returns its signing secret once.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/webhooks` → `201` |
| Scope | `webhooks:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `webhooks_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id webhooks create` |
| Secret | `data.secret` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string (uri) | yes | A public HTTPS URL. Signed deliveries are POSTed here. At most 500 characters. |
| `event_types` | list of string | yes | The events it receives. At least 1 items. |
| `signature_scheme` | string | no | How deliveries are signed: `cbox` (X-Cbox-Signature, the default) or `standard_webhooks` (webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature, verifiable with any Standard Webhooks library; the secret is a `whsec_` secret). One of `cbox`, `standard_webhooks`. |
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | The organization it belongs to; it carries that organization's traffic only. Send this or environment_wide. At most 64 characters. |
| `environment_wide` | boolean | no | True to make it the environment's own, carrying EVERY organization's traffic. Send this or organization_id. |

### webhooks.delete

Delete a webhook endpoint. It stops receiving events at once.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/webhooks/{id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `webhooks:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `destructive` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |

| `id` | string (path) | yes | The webhook endpoint id. |

| `id` | string (path) | yes | The webhook endpoint id. |

List the webhook endpoints registered in this environment: URL, owner, subscribed events and whether each is active.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/webhooks` → `200` |
| Scope | `webhooks:read` — required of the key or token. |

Resume a paused webhook endpoint: it receives events again.

|---|---|

Issue a new signing secret for a webhook endpoint, returned once. The old secret stops verifying immediately.

| | |
|---|---|

| Scope | `webhooks:write` — required of the key or token. |

| MCP tool | `webhooks_secret_rotate` |

### webhooks.signature_scheme.change

Change how a webhook endpoint's deliveries are signed (cbox or standard_webhooks). No new secret is issued: a hex secret is used as whsec_ + base64 of itself. Update the receiver first.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/webhooks/{id}/signature-scheme` → `200` |
| Scope | `webhooks:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `webhooks_signature_scheme_change` |
| CLI | `cbox id webhooks signature_scheme change <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The webhook endpoint id. |
| `signature_scheme` | string | yes | The scheme deliveries are signed with from the next attempt. The secret is unchanged: under `standard_webhooks` a 64-hex secret is used as `whsec_` + base64 of the hex string. Update the receiver before you switch. One of `cbox`, `standard_webhooks`. |

### webhooks.update

Change a webhook endpoint's URL and/or the events it subscribes to.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `PATCH /api/v1/webhooks/{id}` → `200` |
| Scope | `webhooks:write` — required of the key or token. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `webhooks_update` |
| CLI | `cbox id webhooks update <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes | The webhook endpoint id. |
| `url` | string (uri) | no | A public HTTPS URL. Left out, unchanged. At most 500 characters. |
| `event_types` | list of string | no | The COMPLETE set of events afterwards. Left out, unchanged. At least 1 items. |
